disease: Lysosomal acid lipase deficiency (Wolman disease / cholesteryl ester storage disease)

emergence.disease: Lysosomal acid lipase deficiency (Wolman disease / cholesteryl ester storage disease)
emergence.summary: A single-gene LIPA loss-of-function. Lysosomal acid lipase (LAL) is the lysosomal enzyme that hydrolyses the cholesteryl esters and triglycerides delivered to the lysosome by receptor-mediated LDL endocytosis, releasing free cholesterol and free fatty acids. LIPA LOF lowers that lysosomal lipid-catabolism throughput, so cholesteryl esters and triglycerides ACCUMULATE in the lysosomes of hepatocytes, macrophages, adrenal cortex and intestinal mucosa -> hepatomegaly with micro/macrovesicular steatosis and fibrosis, dyslipidaemia (raised LDL-cholesterol, low HDL) and accelerated atherosclerosis. The disease is a clinical continuum: near-complete LAL loss gives the fulminant infantile Wolman phenotype (hepatosplenomegaly, malabsorption, adrenal calcification, early death), while residual activity gives the later-onset cholesteryl ester storage disease (CESD). The catabolic-throughput axis is driven DOWN; the correction is to restore enzymatic throughput. Read on the SAME deficient-enzyme / substrate-accumulation level axis as Gaucher, Fabry and Pompe -- but on a LIPID (cholesteryl-ester + triglyceride) substrate, the SIXTH lysosomal-storage read and the FIRST whose stored substrate is a neutral lipid handled by enzyme replacement (the contrast to cystinosis on the same organelle, whose lesion is a cystine TRANSPORT defect corrected by a small-molecule depleter rather than by replacing an enzyme). The kit re-derives the approved throughput-restore arm -- replace LAL via recombinant human lysosomal acid lipase (sebelipase alfa). Lipid-lowering agents (statins / ezetimibe) lower the circulating LDL-cholesterol burden but do NOT restore the lysosomal enzyme and are recorded as downstream-symptomatic NON-levers (the XLH/Rett downstream-agent discipline). The gamma read is of the LIPA locus switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesion is coding/splice (notably the common exon-8 splice-junction E8SJM c.894G>A allele of CESD, and null alleles in Wolman), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: lysosomal neutral-lipid catabolism (lysosomal acid lipase / LIPA throughput on cholesteryl esters + triglycerides)

per_gene.note: LIPA encodes lysosomal acid lipase (LAL / acid cholesteryl ester hydrolase), the lysosomal enzyme that hydrolyses cholesteryl esters and triglycerides arriving via LDL endocytosis, liberating free cholesterol and fatty acids. LOF lowers lysosomal neutral-lipid catabolism -> cholesteryl esters and triglycerides accumulate in lysosomes of liver, macrophages, adrenal and gut. Autosomal recessive (10q23.31). NCBI official symbol LIPA. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the coding/splice lesions (e.g. the CESD exon-8 splice-site c.894G>A; Wolman null alleles) are outside the promoter firewall.

falsifiers.claim: LIPA LOF lowers lysosomal neutral-lipid catabolism (cholesteryl esters + triglycerides accumulate)
falsifiers.falsifier: a LIPA LOF allele that INCREASED lysosomal acid lipase throughput, or hepatocytes/macrophages in which LIPA loss REDUCED lysosomal cholesteryl-ester content, refutes the throughput-down direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: lysosomal acid lipase activity and lysosomal cholesteryl-ester / triglyceride content in LIPA-deficient cells / liver

falsifiers.claim: restoring enzyme throughput (replace LAL) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if supplying recombinant lysosomal acid lipase REDUCED catabolic throughput or RAISED lysosomal lipid storage, the 'replace enzyme' lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: hepatic-lipid / lysosomal cholesteryl-ester clearance response to recombinant LAL in patient-derived cells / liver
